div.div: The short access token has expired, so the app asks for a new one with its long-lived refresh token. Auth checks the token and replaces it in one atomic database statement: the old token is revoked and a new one created at the same moment. That is why the same token can never be used for two refreshes (race-condition protection).

text.tspan: The short access token has expired, so the app asks for a new one with its long-lived refresh token. Auth checks the token and replaces it in one atomic database statement: the old token is revoked and a new one created at the same moment. That is why the same token can never
be used for two refreshes (race-condition protection).
